# Competition train.csv

- 9,500 labeled problems, 7 categories. Already in our local data.
- LB6 used the **full train.csv as validation** (≈10× the 950 holdout) — not for training — relying on distribution-matched synthetic instead. Inferred test = 500 problems (250/250 public/private), so 0.01 LB ≈ 3 problems.
